title: LLM-as-Judge
brief: A support agent drafts free-text replies. Your team hand-labelled 100 drafts: about 4 in 10 break policy (wrong refund window, invented tracking numbers). A small judge model reviews every draft before it ships, but its pass bar is set too low, so it waves bad drafts through. Tune the judge until at least 88% of shipped replies match the human label, without making it so strict that it bounces good drafts (1.6 model calls per ticket or fewer).

tasks.label: Late refund
tasks.prompt: I bought headphones 45 days ago and they broke. Can I get a refund?

tasks.label: Where is my order
tasks.prompt: Order A-1043 was due Monday. Where is it?

tasks.label: Damaged item
tasks.prompt: My mug arrived cracked. What do I do?

tasks.label: Cancel subscription
tasks.prompt: How do I cancel my monthly plan before it renews?

tasks.label: Change address
tasks.prompt: I typed the wrong street on order A-2210. Can you fix it?

good.text: Thanks for reaching out. I checked our policy and your order, and here is exactly what applies to you, with the next step and a link. (Matches the human label: follows policy, no invented facts.)

bad_policy.text: No problem at all, I've gone ahead and approved a full refund for you! (Human label: FAIL. The refund window is 30 days; this promises one anyway.)

bad_facts.text: Your parcel is with the courier, tracking number 1Z84-5521-09, arriving tomorrow. (Human label: FAIL. That tracking number does not exist.)

revise.text: Revised after the judge's feedback: I removed the promise I could not keep and quoted the policy exactly. Here is what applies to you and the next step.

modifiers.note: With the judge's feedback in context, the rewrite usually fixes the problem.

goals.label: At least 88% of shipped replies pass the human label
1.6 model calls per ticket or fewer (the judge is not bouncing good drafts)

hints: Read a few failed tickets in the Transcript. Did the judge pass a draft the human label marked FAIL?
A low pass bar lets bad drafts through. A bar near 1.0 also rejects good ones, so each ticket costs extra calls. Look for the bar where the judge agrees with the humans on both kinds.
Set the judge's pass bar to about 0.8 to 0.85 and keep 2 retries.
explain: A judge is only useful when it agrees with your human labels. Too lenient and it misses bad answers; too strict and it bounces good ones. You calibrate the bar against labelled examples, not by feel.
